name: Monkeypox in the United States and Around the World: Current
snippet: The ongoing global outbreak of clade IIb monkeypox has caused more than 100,000 cases in 122 total countries, including 115 countries where monkeypox was not previously reported. Several countries in West Africa have been experiencing an outbreak of clade II monkeypox since Summer 2025.
